div.p: Demonstration only. This is a class project showing how a state return could be computed from the federal return on the IRS's published code. It is not an IRS or Virginia Tax service and files nothing.

Because you lived in Virginia for all of , Virginia starts your state return from your federal adjusted gross income. The next screen shows a few lines of Form 760 computed from the answers you already gave.

What this prototype covers: the standard deduction, exemptions, the age deduction, the filing threshold, and the tax rate schedule (Va. Code §§ 58.1-320, 58.1-321, 58.1-322.03). What it leaves out: itemized deductions, other additions and subtractions, every credit, part-year and nonresident returns, and a spouse's age deduction.
